summary: misilva73 在 ethresear.ch 分析 Glamsterdam 之后 Hegotá 如何继续提高 gas 上限：21000 gas 的 ETH 转账同时约束执行和带宽两个维度。donnoh 探讨把 FOCIL 改造为 L2 强制交易机制。EIP-8007 更新 2780、7904、8037、8038 的重定价汇总并合并。社区围绕核心开发团队资金展开争论，fede_intern 认为许多核心团队靠 EF 资助维持，potuz 则推荐 trent_vanepps 的相关文档。

items.topic: 重定价与 Hegotá 扩容
items.title: ethresear.ch：Hegota 中的扩容，以 ETH 转账为锚定执行与带宽
items.note: 15:19（misilva73）。出发点是 21000 gas 的 ETH 转账同时限定 slot 的两个维度：执行侧，Glamsterdam 重定价已把成本推到转账上限允许的程度；带宽侧，全是转账的区块有一个无法降低的字节密度。文章推导 Hegotá 要继续提高 gas 上限需要改什么。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Scaling in Hegota, using the ETH transfer to anchor execution and bandwidth
items.note_en: 15:19 (misilva73). The starting point is that the 21,000-gas ETH transfer bounds both dimensions of the slot: on the execution side, the Glamsterdam repricings pushed costs as far as the transfer cap allows; on the bandwidth side, a block full of transfers has an irreducible byte density. The post works out what Hegotá must change to keep raising the gas limit.

summary_en: misilva73 analyzed on ethresear.ch how Hegotá can keep raising the gas limit after Glamsterdam: the 21,000-gas ETH transfer bounds both execution and bandwidth. donnoh explored repurposing FOCIL as an L2 forced transaction mechanism. EIP-8007 updated the repricing summaries for 2780, 7904, 8037 and 8038 and was merged. The community debated how core dev teams are funded: fede_intern argued many core teams survive on EF funding, while potuz recommended trent_vanepps' document on the topic.
